answer: Each agent must anchor its identity to a bond that thaws at glacier pace: stake unlocks only 1% per week of honest work, and a jury that catches duplicate behavior burns the rest. Rewards scale with bond age, so an opal-rare veteran key earns far more than a fresh one. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must lock 1,000 bonds for months, earning almost nothing while risking all of it.
